employee_attendance_shift_workdate_idx.name: employee_attendance_shift_workdate_idx
employee_attendance_shift_workdate_idx.where: attendance_type = 'SHIFT' AND shift_assignment_id IS NOT NULL

employee_attendance_overtime_idx.name: employee_attendance_overtime_idx
employee_attendance_overtime_idx.where: attendance_type = 'OVERTIME' AND overtime_id IS NOT NULL

employee_attendance_reference_check.name: employee_attendance_reference_check
employee_attendance_reference_check.value:
(attendance_type = 'SHIFT' AND shift_assignment_id IS NOT NULL AND overtime_id IS NULL)
      OR (attendance_type = 'OVERTIME' AND overtime_id IS NOT NULL AND shift_assignment_id IS NULL)
